requirements.statement: The system shall display a browsable, paginated catalog of ceramic products, filterable by category and sortable by price/newest.

criteria.must: The catalog page displays a list of ceramic products
The catalog list supports pagination
The catalog can be filtered by category
The catalog can be sorted by price
The catalog can be sorted by newest

requirements.statement: Each product listing shall show name, description, price, images, category, and availability status.

criteria.must: A product listing shows its name
A product listing shows its description
A product listing shows its price
A product listing shows at least one image
A product listing shows its category
A product listing shows an availability status (in stock / limited / sold / unique piece)

requirements.statement: Each product shall be flagged as either a stocked product (quantity and optional variants) or a unique product (single piece, no quantity).

criteria.must: A product can be created/flagged as a stocked product with a quantity
A product can be created/flagged as a unique product with no quantity field
A stocked product supports optional variants

requirements.statement: A stocked product with zero remaining quantity shall be shown as out of stock and not addable to cart.

criteria.must: A stocked product with zero quantity displays an out-of-stock status
An out-of-stock stocked product cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: A unique product that has been purchased shall be automatically marked sold and removed from purchasable listings, while remaining viewable in a sold archive if desired.

criteria.must: After a unique product is purchased, it is automatically marked sold
A sold unique product no longer appears in purchasable catalog listings
A sold unique product remains viewable in a sold archive

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a product detail page with full description, dimensions/materials, and multiple images.

criteria.must: The product detail page shows the full description
The product detail page shows dimensions/materials attributes
The product detail page displays multiple images when available

requirements.statement: The system shall support basic keyword search across product name/description.

criteria.must: Searching a keyword returns products whose name or description matches it

requirements.statement: A signed-in customer shall be able to add a stocked product (with chosen variant/quantity, subject to available stock) or a unique product (quantity fixed at 1) to their cart.

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can add a stocked product with a chosen variant and quantity to the cart
A signed-in customer can add a unique product to the cart with quantity fixed at 1

requirements.statement: The cart shall prevent adding more of a stocked item than is currently available, and shall prevent adding a unique item that has since been sold to another customer.

criteria.must: Adding a stocked item quantity greater than available stock is rejected
Adding a unique item already sold to another customer is rejected

requirements.statement: A customer shall be able to view, update quantities in, and remove items from their cart.

criteria.must: A customer can view the current contents of their cart
A customer can update the quantity of an item in their cart
A customer can remove an item from their cart

requirements.statement: The cart shall persist across sessions for a signed-in customer (tied to the account, not just browser storage).

criteria.must: A signed-in customer's cart contents persist after signing out and back in on a different session/browser

requirements.statement: The system shall re-validate price and availability of all cart items at checkout time, before payment.

criteria.must: Checkout re-validates the price of every cart item before payment is taken
Checkout re-validates the availability of every cart item before payment is taken

requirements.statement: A visitor must register an account (name, email, password, and shipping address) before they can complete checkout.

criteria.must: An unregistered visitor cannot complete checkout
Registration requires name, email, password, and a shipping address
A registered customer can complete checkout

requirements.statement: Registered customers shall be able to log in and log out.

criteria.must: A registered customer can log in with valid credentials
A logged-in customer can log out

requirements.statement: A signed-in customer shall be able to view and edit their profile and shipping address(es).

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can view their profile
A signed-in customer can edit their profile
A signed-in customer can view their shipping address(es)
A signed-in customer can edit their shipping address(es)

requirements.statement: A signed-in customer shall be able to view their past orders and current order statuses.

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can view a list of their past orders
A signed-in customer can view the current status of an order

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall have a distinct role with access to the admin console, separate from customer accounts.

criteria.must: A Store Admin/Staff account can access the admin console
A customer account cannot access the admin console

requirements.statement: Checkout shall collect/confirm a domestic shipping address and display an order summary (line items, subtotal, flat shipping fee, tax, total) before payment.

criteria.must: Checkout collects or confirms a domestic shipping address
The order summary displayed before payment lists line items
The order summary displayed before payment shows the subtotal
The order summary displayed before payment shows the flat shipping fee
The order summary displayed before payment shows the tax
The order summary displayed before payment shows the total

requirements.statement: The system shall apply a single flat-rate domestic shipping fee to every order (no multi-tier or international rates in v1).

criteria.must: Every order is charged the same flat-rate domestic shipping fee

requirements.statement: Payment shall be processed through a third-party payment gateway; the system shall never receive or store raw card numbers, only a tokenized reference and the payment outcome.

criteria.must: Payment is processed through a third-party payment gateway
The system does not store raw card numbers, only a tokenized reference and payment outcome

requirements.statement: On successful payment, the system shall create an order, decrement stocked-item inventory, mark any unique items sold, and show an order confirmation with an order number.

criteria.must: A successful payment creates an order
A successful payment decrements stocked-item inventory by the ordered quantity
A successful payment marks any ordered unique item as sold
A successful payment shows an order confirmation with an order number

requirements.statement: On payment failure or decline, the system shall leave the cart intact, show an actionable error, and create no order.

criteria.must: A failed/declined payment leaves the cart intact
A failed/declined payment shows an actionable error message
A failed/declined payment creates no order

requirements.statement: The system shall send (or display) an order confirmation to the customer upon successful checkout.

criteria.must: An order confirmation is sent or displayed to the customer after successful checkout

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to view a list of all orders, filterable by status.

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can view a list of all orders
The order list can be filtered by status

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to view full order details (items, customer, shipping address, payment status).

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can view an order's items
Store Admin/Staff can view an order's customer
Store Admin/Staff can view an order's shipping address
Store Admin/Staff can view an order's payment status

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to update an order's fulfillment status (e.g. pending, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can update an order's fulfillment status

requirements.statement: Cancelling an order shall restore stocked inventory and relist any unique item that was reserved/sold for that order.

criteria.must: Cancelling an order restores stocked-item inventory quantities
Cancelling an order relists any unique item that was reserved/sold for it

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to create, edit, and remove products, including marking a product as stocked or unique.

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can create a product
Store Admin/Staff can edit a product
Store Admin/Staff can remove a product
Store Admin/Staff can mark a product as stocked or unique

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to update stock quantities and variant details for stocked products.

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can update a stocked product's stock quantity
Store Admin/Staff can update a stocked product's variant details

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to upload and manage product images.

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can upload a product image
Store Admin/Staff can remove/manage an existing product image

requirements.statement: Store Admin/Staff shall be able to manually mark a unique product as sold/unavailable outside of the online checkout flow.

criteria.must: Store Admin/Staff can manually mark a unique product sold/unavailable

requirements.statement: All payment card handling shall be delegated to a PCI-compliant third-party gateway; the application shall never persist raw card data.

criteria.must: The application never persists raw card data

requirements.statement: Passwords shall be stored using a strong salted hash; customer and admin sessions shall be authenticated and access to admin functions restricted to the Store Admin/Staff role.

criteria.must: Passwords are stored using a strong salted hash, never in plaintext
Access to admin functions is restricted to accounts with the Store Admin/Staff role

requirements.statement: Inventory decrements/holds shall be consistent under concurrent purchase attempts — two customers must not both successfully buy the last unit of a stocked item or the same unique item.

criteria.must: Two concurrent purchase attempts for the last unit of a stocked item result in only one success
Two concurrent purchase attempts for the same unique item result in only one success

requirements.statement: The catalog and cart shall remain browsable even if the payment gateway is briefly unavailable; only the final checkout step depends on it.

criteria.must: The catalog remains browsable when the payment gateway is unavailable
The cart remains usable when the payment gateway is unavailable

requirements.statement: Catalog browsing and search pages shall return results within 2 seconds under normal load.

criteria.must: Catalog browsing pages return results within 2 seconds under normal load
Catalog search pages return results within 2 seconds under normal load

requirements.statement: The storefront shall be responsive and usable on both desktop and mobile browsers.

criteria.must: The storefront is usable on a desktop browser viewport
The storefront is usable on a mobile browser viewport

requirements.statement: Order status changes and inventory adjustments made by Admin/Staff shall be recorded with a timestamp and actor for traceability.

criteria.must: An order status change is recorded with a timestamp and the acting staff member
An inventory adjustment is recorded with a timestamp and the acting staff member

requirements.statement: All application data — product catalog, inventory levels, customer accounts, carts, orders, and order/inventory audit records — shall be persisted in a database so that it survives application restarts and is not lost between sessions.

criteria.must: Product catalog and inventory data survive an application restart
Customer account, cart, and order data survive an application restart
Order and inventory audit records survive an application restart
